value.name: masking
value.prompt: Predict the participant emotional states using only the supplied fallible inputs. Return only JSON {"emotions":["emotion expression", ...]}. Vocabulary and number of emotions are unrestricted; an empty list is permitted. Do not invent events, diagnoses or physiological causes. If EEG maps are supplied, the two fixed-scale five-band maps summarize seconds0-5 and5-10 of one segment; red is higher displayed power and blue lower. Upper/lower image halves are not anatomical lobes. A numerical EEG residual, when enabled, is an auxiliary representation of the same EEG. Measurements do not uniquely establish any emotion. If video is supplied, it depicts the stimulus, not the participant; use it as fallible context without equating the depicted emotion with the participant experience. Missing inputs provide no evidence and should not be imagined.
